在供应商设置中检查连接条件，\n然后开启你需要的服务。:
Check connection requirements in Settings,
then enable the services you use.
不合并团队额度；无上限或周期额度为 0 时不计算百分比。: Team credits are excluded. No percentage is calculated for unlimited or zero-credit periods.
检测安装条件不等于验证登录。新服务由你决定是否开启；关闭后停止查询。: Installation detection does not verify sign-in. Enable each service individually; disabling it stops polling.
条件：使用 ChatGPT 账号登录 Codex；API Key 登录不能读取订: Requires Codex signed in with a ChatGPT account. API keys cannot retrieve subscription quotas.
条件：agy ≥ 1.1.11，并已在终端运行 agy 完成登录。开启后约每分钟: Requires agy ≥ 1.1.11 and sign-in via agy in Terminal. Refreshes about once a minute when enabled; failures slow or pause polling.
验证只查询一次，不会自动打开开关。无需填写 API Key 或 Bearer。: Verification makes one request without enabling monitoring. No API key or Bearer is required.
支持 Codex、Antigravity、Claude Code、TeamoRo: Supports Codex, Antigravity, Claude Code, TeamoRouter and Warp. Detection does not scan or upload conversations.
依次展示已开启服务的额度组；只有一组时保持显示。弹窗打开时暂停切换，不影响自动刷: Cycles through enabled quota groups. With one group, it stays fixed. Rotation pauses while the popover is open; polling continues.
请先在“服务与账号”中开启一个供应商。: Enable a provider in Services & Accounts first.
每次显示一个额度组的两行数据，不混合不同服务的余额。设置自动保存，轮播不会增加接: Shows two lines from one quota group at a time. Settings save automatically; rotation makes no extra API requests.
Touch Bar 跟随菜单栏当前额度组，切换与轮播时同步更新。小猫活跃度取当前: Touch Bar follows the current menu-bar group, including rotation. The cat uses the lower remaining quota. Refresh queries only the current provider.
菜单栏跟随系统单色；窗口自动适配浅色和深色。所有时间使用系统时区。: The menu bar uses system monochrome colors. Windows support light and dark appearance. All times use the system time zone.
条件：先使用 Claude 订阅账号登录 Claude Code，并允许读取登录: Sign in to Claude Code with a Claude subscription and allow credential access. Using a TeamoRouter API key? Configure TeamoRouter below instead. This section only reads official subscription quotas; other proxies, Bedrock and Vertex are not supported.
每 5 分钟独立刷新，无需保持 Claude Code 运行。内部额度接口可能变: Refreshes independently every 5 minutes. Claude Code can be closed. The internal API may change or rate-limit requests. If credentials expire, sign in again in Claude Code and verify.
只读查询；必要时弹出钥匙串授权提示。限流冷却期间不会再次请求。: Read-only request. Keychain access may require approval. No requests are made during a rate-limit cooldown.
验证只查询一次，不会开启自动监控。不复制或上传凭据到第三方，不刷新或改写 Cla: Verification makes one request without enabling monitoring. Credentials are not sent to third parties or rewritten. Only the default Claude Code configuration directory is supported.
个人 API Key · 直连 Warp · 每 5 分钟刷新: Personal API key · Direct to Warp · Every 5 minutes
在 Warp Settings → Platform → API Keys 创建: Create a personal key in Warp Settings → Platform → API Keys, not a team Agent Key. Only credits are queried; no AI tasks run and no sign-in sessions are read or changed.
个人 API Key（wk-…；留空保留已保存密钥）: Personal API key (wk-…; blank keeps saved key)
保存到本机登录钥匙串；输入框不会回显密钥。验证只查一次，不自动开启监控。内部额度: Stored in the local login Keychain; saved keys are never displayed. Verification runs once without enabling monitoring. The internal API may change. Bonus credits are separate; team credits are excluded.
已安全保存，请验证连接。: Saved securely. Please verify the connection.
仅回写 Codex 的实时账户额度。其他供应商不会发送到此接口；关闭 Codex: Sends only live Codex account quotas. Other providers are not sent to this endpoint. Disabling Codex monitoring pauses automatic reporting.
手动值会明确标记，不参与回写；下一次自动刷新会覆盖。: Manual values are labeled and never sent. The next refresh replaces them.
请填写 Bearer 和 Codex Key ID: Enter a Bearer token and Codex Key ID
Claude Code API 接入 · 账户余额 / 当前 Key 用量: Claude Code via API · Account balance / Current key usage
适用于 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 指向 TeamoRouter、使用: For Claude Code using ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL with TeamoRouter and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN. No official Claude subscription or running CLI is needed.
留空保留已保存密钥: Leave blank to keep the saved key
表单尚未保存；监控仍使用已保存配置。请先保存，再验证。: Unsaved changes. Monitoring still uses the saved configuration. Save before verifying.
正在查询余额、今日消费和 Token…: Fetching balance, today's cost and tokens…
导入只填入表单，不执行 .zshrc；点击保存后写入本机钥匙串。已保存配置优先于: Import fills this form without executing .zshrc. Save writes to the local Keychain. Saved settings override environment variables. Verification runs once; enabled monitoring refreshes every 5 minutes.
今日按本机时区统计；余额为账户共享金额，用量为当前 Key 的所有模型，不仅是: Today uses the local time zone. Balance is shared by the account; usage covers all models for this key, not just Claude. Without a quota total, no percentage is shown and the cat sleeps.
已导入到表单（密钥已隐藏），请保存后验证。未修改 .zshrc。: Imported into the form (key hidden). Save, then verify. .zshrc was not changed.
已保存到钥匙串，请验证连接。: Saved to Keychain. Please verify the connection.
Claude Code API · 按量计费: Claude Code API · Pay as you go
余额属于账户；今日消费与用量属于当前 Key，包含所有模型。: Balance belongs to the account. Today's cost and usage cover all models for this key.
兼容 macOS 14 的玻璃风格，非新版系统 Liquid Glass API: Glass-inspired styling for macOS 14, not the newer system Liquid Glass API.
只改变外观，不改变读取频率、额度颜色含义或供应商 Logo。: Appearance only. Polling, quota color meanings and provider logos stay unchanged.
系统已开启“减少动态效果”，当前不播放界面动效。: Reduce Motion is enabled in macOS. Interface animations are disabled.
轻柔：切换淡入淡出、数值过渡、刷新成功微光。无持续粒子动画，离开应用或关闭弹窗后: Gentle: fades, number transitions and a subtle success glow. No continuous particles. Effects stop when the app is inactive or the popover closes.
主题适用于弹窗和设置；菜单栏保持系统单色。减少透明度或增强对比度时使用实色背景。: Themes apply to the popover and settings; the menu bar stays monochrome. Reduce Transparency or Increase Contrast uses solid backgrounds. Touch Bar cat behavior is unchanged.
回写需要实时账户额度同时提供 5 小时和每周窗口: Reporting requires both live 5-hour and weekly account quotas
不含或包含 Bearer 前缀均可: With or without the Bearer prefix
验证会发送一次当前额度，不会计入失败次数。: Verification sends the current quota once and does not count toward consecutive failures.
连续失败 %d 次，自动回写已暂停。请修正配置后保存。: Reporting paused after %d consecutive failures. Correct and save your configuration.
请从 .zshrc 导入或保存 TeamoRouter 配置。: Import from .zshrc or save your TeamoRouter configuration.
请使用 HTTPS TeamoRouter 根地址和有效 Bearer；不支持其: Use the HTTPS TeamoRouter root URL and a valid Bearer token. Other proxies are not supported.
仅支持 .zshrc 中顶层、单行的字面量赋值；动态变量或条件配置请手动填写。未: Only top-level, single-line literal assignments in .zshrc are supported. Enter dynamic or conditional values manually. No shell commands were executed.
无法读取 ~/.zshrc，请手动填写配置。: Cannot read ~/.zshrc. Enter the configuration manually.
无法访问 TeamoRouter 钥匙串配置，请点击保存或验证并允许访问。: Cannot access TeamoRouter credentials. Click Save or Verify and allow Keychain access.
TeamoRouter 密钥失效或权限不足，自动读取已暂停。: TeamoRouter key is invalid or lacks permission. Automatic polling is paused.
TeamoRouter 请求受限，冷却期间暂停查询。: TeamoRouter rate limit reached. Polling is paused during cooldown.
TeamoRouter 返回的数据不完整或格式不符，未将其当作零余额。: TeamoRouter returned incomplete or unexpected data. This is not treated as a zero balance.
无法连接 TeamoRouter，请检查网络后重试。: Cannot connect to TeamoRouter. Check your network and retry.
请保存 Warp 个人 API Key 后验证。: Save a Warp personal API key, then verify.
无法访问钥匙串，请点击保存或验证并允许访问。: Cannot access Keychain. Click Save or Verify and allow access.
Warp 密钥失效或权限不足；请更换个人 API Key。自动读取已暂停。: Warp key is invalid or lacks permission. Replace your personal API key. Polling is paused.
Warp 请求受限，冷却期间暂停查询。: Warp rate limit reached. Polling is paused during cooldown.
Warp 未返回可识别的额度，内部接口可能已变化。: Warp returned no recognized quota. The internal API may have changed.
无法连接 Warp，请检查网络后重试。: Cannot connect to Warp. Check your network and retry.
Warp 返回 HTTP %d，稍后重试。: Warp returned HTTP %d. Try again later.
未找到 agy。请安装官方 Antigravity CLI，或选择已安装的可执行: agy was not found. Install the official Antigravity CLI or select its executable.
CLI 路径不可执行。请选择 agy 文件的绝对路径。: The CLI path is not executable. Select an absolute path to agy.
需要 agy 1.1.11 或更新的正式版本。请更新 CLI 后重新验证。: Requires stable agy 1.1.11 or newer. Update the CLI, then verify.
CLI 无法启动。请检查文件权限或重新安装。: Cannot start the CLI. Check file permissions or reinstall.
查询超时，已停止本次进程。请检查网络后重试。: The query timed out and its process was stopped. Check your network and retry.
CLI 输出超过安全上限，已停止查询。请检查版本。: CLI output exceeded the safety limit. Query stopped; check the CLI version.
未找到有效登录。请先在对应官方客户端或 CLI 中登录，再验证。: No valid sign-in found. Sign in with the official app or CLI, then verify.
Claude Code 登录已过期。请在 Claude Code 中重新登录，再: Claude Code credentials expired. Sign in again, then verify the connection.
无法读取 Claude Code 钥匙串。请解锁登录钥匙串，点击验证连接并允许访: Cannot read Claude Code credentials. Unlock the login Keychain, click Verify and allow access.
账号没有查询权限或订阅资格。请检查当前登录账号。: The account lacks permission or an eligible subscription. Check the signed-in account.
服务暂时限流，自动刷新已放缓。请稍后重试。: The service is rate-limiting requests. Polling has slowed; try later.
请求失败。请检查网络、代理和官方服务状态后重试。: Request failed. Check your network, proxy and service status, then retry.
没有读到有效额度，可能是接口格式变化。请更新客户端后重试。: No valid quota received. The API format may have changed. Update the client and retry.
CLI 将额度查询识别为对话，已暂停自动查询。请更新 agy 后重新验证。: The CLI interpreted the quota query as a conversation. Polling is paused. Update agy and verify again.
服务返回 HTTP %d。请稍后重试。: The service returned HTTP %d. Try again later.
